name: nuclo-example-router-ssr
description: Server-side rendering and hydration with nuclo-router: one Route per request, real 404 status codes, code-split pages, idle preloading and a non-root base.

scripts.build:deps: bun run --cwd ../../packages/nuclo-core build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/nuclo-router build
scripts.build: bun run build:deps && tsc && bun run build:client
scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently --kill-others --names vite,server -c cyan,magenta "vite build --watch" "bun --watch src/server.ts"
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun run start
